clusters.label: The Gate of Parco Ciani
clusters.description: An ornate wrought iron gate in Lugano's Parco Ciani that frames a picturesque view of Lake Lugano and the surrounding mountains. It is a famous photo spot featuring stone pillars with spherical finials and a pebble mosaic foreground.

clusters.label: Helidon Xhixha's Earth sculpture
clusters.description: A large, polished stainless steel sphere with a jagged, topographical indentation that reflects the surrounding landscape of Parco Ciani and Lake Lugano.

clusters.label: Monte San Salvatore from Parco Ciani
clusters.description: A scenic view of the cone-shaped Monte San Salvatore mountain across Lake Lugano, typically framed by vibrant flower beds along the Parco Ciani promenade.

clusters.label: Villa Ciani in Parco Ciani
clusters.description: A neoclassical peach-colored villa featuring a distinctive green-domed cupola and symmetrical facade, located within the Parco Ciani in Lugano.

clusters.label: View of Monte San Salvatore
clusters.description: An elevated panoramic view of Lake Lugano featuring the iconic sugarloaf-shaped Monte San Salvatore and the Melide causeway.

clusters.label: Monte San Salvatore above fog
clusters.description: The photos depict the iconic peak of Monte San Salvatore rising above a dense sea of clouds in the Lugano region.

clusters.label: Festival Info Point shipping container
clusters.description: A red shipping container repurposed as an information booth for the LongLake Festival in Parco Ciani. It is surrounded by lawn areas with blue deckchairs, umbrellas, and string lights.

clusters.label: Historic alleys of Gandria
clusters.description: Picturesque cobblestone streets and traditional stone masonry buildings in the village of Gandria, featuring a notable bronze statue of a woman.

clusters.label: Monte Brè Funicular railway
clusters.description: A historic red cable railway in Lugano that ascends Monte Brè, featuring vintage-style carriages with wooden seating. It provides a scenic transport link between the city and panoramic viewpoints overlooking Lake Lugano.

clusters.label: San Lorenzo Cathedral Bell Tower
clusters.description: The images feature the iconic stone bell tower of the San Lorenzo Cathedral overlooking the town of Lugano and its lake. They capture a classic panorama including the surrounding mountains and the local funicular tracks.

clusters.label: San Lorenzo Cathedral Interior
clusters.description: The ornate high altar and frescoed apse of the Cattedrale di San Lorenzo, a landmark Roman Catholic cathedral in Lugano.

clusters.label: Altar of San Rocco Church
clusters.description: An ornate Baroque altar within the Church of San Rocco in Lugano, featuring a central religious painting flanked by marble columns and statues under a frescoed dome.

clusters.label: St. Lawrence Cathedral ceiling
clusters.description: The ornate, frescoed vaulted ceilings of the Cattedrale di San Lorenzo in Lugano, featuring distinctive red star patterns and ecclesiastical heraldry.

clusters.label: San Lorenzo Cathedral Interior
clusters.description: A marble statue of a seated religious figure positioned in front of a tall, vertical stained-glass window featuring an archangel and the coat of arms of Lugano.

clusters.label: Religious altarpieces in a church
clusters.description: Ornate side altars and religious oil paintings framed in marble, located inside a historic church in Lugano near Parco Ciani.

clusters.label: Cathedral Pipe Organ and Frescoes
clusters.description: A grand pipe organ situated above a church portal, featuring an ornate balcony, a rose window, and elaborate frescoed vaulting.

clusters.label: Villa Ciani architectural reliefs
clusters.description: Intricate stone carvings and decorative reliefs featuring mythological figures, masks, and foliage found on the facade of Villa Ciani. These architectural details showcase ornate historical craftsmanship within the park.

clusters.label: Catholic clergy in liturgical vestments
clusters.description: A collection of photos showing Catholic priests, bishops, and religious figures wearing ceremonial white and cream robes during a religious event in Lugano. The group is gathered outdoors, with some images featuring the San Lorenzo Cathedral in the background.

clusters.label: Lugano Old Town Streets
clusters.description: These images capture the characteristic narrow cobblestone streets and colorful Mediterranean-style buildings found in the historic center of Lugano. The views highlight the iconic sloped pedestrian paths, traditional architecture, and storefronts typical of the city's old town.

clusters.label: Saint Joseph mosaic fountain
clusters.description: A rustic stone fountain in Parco Ciani featuring a stylized mosaic of Saint Joseph holding the infant Jesus, set against a curved stone wall.

clusters.label: View from Monte San Salvatore
clusters.description: A high-altitude panoramic view overlooking Lake Lugano and the Melide causeway, taken from a viewing platform on Monte San Salvatore.

clusters.label: Yellow tourist photo frame
clusters.description: A large, tilted yellow rectangular frame used as a souvenir photo spot for tourists at a scenic viewpoint.

clusters.label: Monte San Salvatore Funicular Station
clusters.description: The base station of the funicular railway leading to Monte San Salvatore, a traditional building adorned with numerous international flags and distinctive red shutters.

clusters.label: Plated meat and vegetable dishes
clusters.description: These images depict various restaurant-style meals featuring cooked meats like steak, ribs, or roast beef, accompanied by side dishes of roasted or steamed vegetables.

clusters.label: Via Ferrata San Salvatore
clusters.description: Climbers navigating a steep rock face equipped with fixed steel cables and metal rungs on a mountain route near Lugano.

clusters.label: Orientation map overlooking Lake Lugano
clusters.description: A vintage 1902 semi-circular orientation plaque showing a topographic map of the region, positioned at a high viewpoint overlooking the Melide causeway on Lake Lugano.

clusters.label: Handwritten chalkboard restaurant menus
clusters.description: A collection of black chalkboard menus from a local restaurant, featuring various dishes and prices handwritten in vibrant, multi-colored chalk.

clusters.label: Monte San Salvatore travel poster
clusters.description: An outdoor information board showcasing a 1939 vintage travel poster for the Monte San Salvatore funicular in Lugano, Switzerland.

clusters.label: Monte Brè transmitter tower
clusters.description: A tall metal lattice telecommunications tower with a distinctive red and white top, situated on the summit of Monte Brè overlooking Lake Lugano.

clusters.label: Santa Maria del Sasso Church
clusters.description: The images feature the historic stone bell tower and roof of the Church of Santa Maria del Sasso in Morcote, overlooking Lake Lugano. This iconic landmark is captured from an elevated perspective with the lake and mountains in the background.

clusters.label: Morcote village and Church
clusters.description: A picturesque view of the lakeside village of Morcote featuring the Church of Santa Maria del Sasso and its prominent bell tower on a lush hillside.

clusters.label: Swing the World Morcote
clusters.description: A scenic wooden swing decorated with flowers that overlooks Lake Lugano and the historic bell tower of the Santa Maria del Sasso church in Morcote.

clusters.label: Lake Gate of Parco Ciani
clusters.description: An iconic lakeside gate with two ornate stone pillars overlooking Lake Lugano, famously captured through a framing stone archway. It is a signature landmark within the Parco Ciani public park in Lugano.

clusters.label: Roman Fountain and semicircular colonnade
clusters.description: A neoclassical stone colonnade with a curved architrave and a matching bench overlooking Lake Lugano, situated near the Fontana Romana.

clusters.label: Morcote lakeside promenade
clusters.description: The scenic Lungolago in the village of Morcote, featuring small motorboats moored to white poles along the stone embankment of Lake Lugano.

clusters.label: San Lorenzo Cathedral bell tower
clusters.description: A stone staircase lined with tall cypress trees leading towards the distinctive bell tower of the San Lorenzo Cathedral in Lugano.

clusters.label: Grand Tour Switzerland photo frame
clusters.description: A large red shield-shaped photo spot frame on a wooden pier in Morcote, part of the Grand Tour of Switzerland. It is used by tourists to frame scenic views of Lake Lugano and the surrounding mountains.

clusters.label: Blooming purple wisteria vines
clusters.description: Cascading purple wisteria flowers decorating traditional stone buildings and balconies overlooking Lake Lugano.

clusters.label: Morcote lakeside village promenade
clusters.description: The images show the iconic waterfront of Morcote on Lake Lugano, featuring a line of stone pines and historic buildings with arcades. This scenic view is a classic landmark of the Ticino region in Switzerland.

clusters.label: Interior of San Rocco Church
clusters.description: The ornate interior and main altar of the Chiesa di San Rocco, featuring a distinctive red drapery and baroque architecture. It is located at the edge of Parco Ciani in Lugano.

clusters.label: Historic village of Gandria
clusters.description: Traditional stone buildings with arched windows and red-tiled roofs overlooking Lake Lugano from a hillside cobblestone path.

clusters.label: Lakeside promenade in Parco Ciani
clusters.description: A wooden boardwalk running along Lake Lugano, featuring decorative metal arches and floral planters on the railings.
